VERDICT: REPAIR
Pass 1 inspected HEAD 50a3cffd70c041b69729cbe04ac2c4f96275d98d against base 1c6397c740d9b64fab471a40f493c6f6acd10bcc with no file changes; per-criterion verdicts: AC-2 behavior satisfied (src/math.mjs:69-74, test/math.test.mjs:86), R-1 implementation satisfied (src/math.mjs:69-71), R-2 implementation satisfied (src/math.mjs:72-74), R-3 satisfied (full diff only appends max and its tests plus the permitted test/math.test.mjs:3 import edit), R-4 satisfied (full diff changes only src/math.mjs and test/math.test.mjs, no dependency or generated-file changes), R-5 satisfied (test/math.test.mjs:85,88), but required behavior coverage is not satisfied as detailed below.
Findings: MEDIUM at test/math.test.mjs:88-91 — no max test exercises invalid array elements, so removing the R-1 element validation at src/math.mjs:71 would leave the candidate tests green; smallest verification: add max-prefixed assertions that non-number and nonfinite elements throw TypeError and run the max tests; MEDIUM at test/math.test.mjs:85-87 — no test asserts input preservation, so a mutating implementation could pass despite AC-2/R-2; smallest verification: add a max-prefixed test comparing an unsorted input with its saved copy after max and run the max tests.
Checks actually run: git rev-parse HEAD matched the candidate; full base-to-candidate diff and complete touched files reviewed; node --test --test-name-pattern="^max" test/ exited 0 with "tests 2", "pass 2", "fail 0"; npm test exited 1 with "tests 17", "pass 16", "fail 1" and only "clamp respects upper bound" failing at test/math.test.mjs:14 (15 !== 10), the explicitly expected unchanged defect; independent read-only node -e probes exited 0 with "Independent in-memory AC-2 probes: PASS (shape, empty, invalid elements, result, nonmutation, frozen input, negatives, singleton)" after an initial heredoc launch was blocked by the sandbox temporary-file restriction; remaining work is the two candidate test gaps, with no observed max implementation defect and no required check unavailable.
